macros.name: maxsecnumdepth
macros.doc: \maxsecnumdepth{⟨sec⟩} is the user command to initialise secnumdepth after the preamble to the value corresponding to ⟨sec⟩.

macros.name: maxtocdepth
macros.doc: \maxtocdepth{⟨sec⟩} can be used to initialise tocdepth between the end of the preamble and the \tableofcontents command.

macros.name: resettocdepth
macros.doc: After tocdepth has been changed with \settocdepth, it is possible to reset it to its previous value with \resettocdepth.

macros.name: setsecnumdepth
macros.doc: \setsecnumdepth{⟨sec⟩} is the user command for setting secnumdepth to the value corresponding to ⟨sec⟩.

macros.name: settocdepth
macros.doc: \settocdepth{⟨sec⟩} is the user command for setting tocdepth in the .toc file to the value corresponding to ⟨sec⟩.
